newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SOCCER-ESTONIA BEAT BELARUS DESPITE LOSING KEY STRIKER OPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ESTONIA BEAT BELARUS DESPITE LOSING KEY STRIKER OPER.

text.p: Estonia lost key striker Andres Oper with a suspected broken leg in the first half but kept their nerve to beat Belarus 1-0 in their World Cup group four qualifier on Saturday.
Oper hobbled off in the 26th minute after being brought down on the edge of the penalty area.
After an undistinguished first half, Estonia broke the deadlock in the 52nd minute when Sergei Hohlov-Simson headed home Martin Reim's curving corner.
Belarus's best chance came late in the first half. A free-kick by Alexander Koulchi swerved around Estonia's three-man wall but the Belarussians failed to score despite a mad scramble in the box.

Estonia: 1-Mart Poom, 2-Marek Lemsalu, 3-Urmas Rooba, 4-Sergei Hohlov-Simson, 5-Indrek Zelinski, 6-Viktor Alonen, 7-Meelis Rooba (Toomas Kallaste 58th), 8-Marko Kristal (Argo Arbeiter 90th), 10-Martin Reim, 11-Andres Oper (Urmas Kirs 26th)

Belarus: 1-Valeri Shantalosov, 2-Sergei Gurenko, 3-Andrei Ostrovski, 4-Sergei Shtanouk, 5-Alexander Khatskevich, 6-Yuri Vergeichik (Vasily Baronov 43rd, Oleg Chernyavski 77th), 7-Alexander Kulchi, 8-Yuri Maleev, 9-Valentin Belkevich, 10-Vladimir Makovski, 11-Petr Katchuro.
